en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor fair or exhibition ground with garden beds and paths in the foreground and various buildings, including a large hall with a tall sign, in the background. The sign on the hall and the caption indicate that this is the trade fair in Elverum in 1936. The lower margin of the card contains printed Norwegian text identifying the event and photographer.
